7659539092af781e332541deffa357badc4cfb5a.translatedText: Output repeats the current result at approximately 20 Hz real time; point cloud matching attempts once at approximately 2 Hz real time; 20 Hz does not mean a new localization is obtained every time\. Here only the output interface is recorded; the previously shelved troubleshooting of navigation start\-stop or TF timeliness faults is still not expanded\.
